WELCOME TO THE GRID

Logic meets mayhem.

A Sudoku puzzle that fights back.

01

Solve to arm the board

Select a blank, then a number. Every correct answer builds a permanent tower and earns energy. Each row, column and 3×3 box needs 1–9.

02

Your answers draw the road

Your latest correct placements bend the enemy route. Build a cluster of complementary towers along the glowing trail.

03

Break the rules to survive

Buy reserve pieces with energy. During combat, place them in blank cells—even wrong answers work. Illegal towers add corruption and disappear after the wave.

04

Hold the core for five waves

Survive, earn a bonus, and return to solving. Mix slow, splash, chain and support towers to keep enemies away from the exit.

Keyboard Arrows: move · 1–9: place · B: buy reserve · Enter: next phase · Space: pause · H: help

Controller D-pad: move · LB/RB: number · A: place · RT: buy · LT: sound · B: back · X: hint · Y: next phase · Start: pause

Touch / mouse Tap a square, then a numbered tower card.
